title: The Sons of the Caliph
author: James Baldwin
summary: 两个王子争着为老师拿鞋，哈里发借此讲述尊敬师长的道理。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1912 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: There was a caliph of Persia whose name was Al Mamoun. He had two sons whom he wished to become honest and noble men. So he employed a wise man whose name was Al Farra to be their teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 波斯有一位哈里发，名叫阿尔·马蒙。他希望两个儿子成为诚实高尚的人，于是请了一位名叫阿尔·法拉的智者做他们的老师。

paragraphs.en: One day, after lesson hours, Al Farra rose to go out of the house. The two boys saw him and ran to fetch his shoes. For in that country, people never wear shoes in the house, but take them off at the door. The two boys ran for the teacher's shoes, and each claimed the honor of carrying them to him. But they dared not quarrel and at last agreed that each should carry one shoe. Thus the honor would be divided.
paragraphs.zh: 一天下课后，阿尔·法拉起身要出门。两个男孩看见，跑去给他取鞋。因为在这个国家，人们在屋里从不穿鞋，到门口就脱下来。两个男孩跑去拿老师的鞋，都争着要把鞋递给他。可他们不敢争吵，最后商定每人拿一只，这样荣誉就平分了。

paragraphs.en: When the caliph heard of this he sent for Al Farra and asked him, "Who is the most honored of men?"
paragraphs.zh: 哈里发听说这件事后，派人叫来阿尔·法拉，问他：“世上最受尊敬的人是谁？”

paragraphs.en: The teacher answered, "I know of no man who is more honored than yourself."
paragraphs.zh: 老师回答：“我不知道有谁比您更受尊敬。”

paragraphs.en: "No, no," said the caliph. "It is the man who rose to go out, and two young princes contended for the honor of giving him his shoes but at last agreed that each should offer him one."
paragraphs.zh: “不，不，”哈里发说，“是那个起身要走、两个小王子争着给他拿鞋、最后商定每人献上一只鞋的人。”

paragraphs.en: Al Farra answered, "Sir, I should have forbidden them to do this, but I feared to discourage them. I hope that I shall never do anything to make them careless of their duties."
paragraphs.zh: 阿尔·法拉回答：“陛下，我本该禁止他们这样做，但我怕打击他们的积极性。我希望自己永远不要做任何事，让他们变得疏忽职守。”

paragraphs.en: "Well," said the caliph, "if you had forbidden them thus to honor you, I should have declared you in the wrong. They did nothing that was beneath the dignity of princes. Indeed, they honored themselves by honoring you." Al Farra bowed low, but said nothing; and the caliph went on. "No young man nor boy," said he, "can be so high in rank as to neglect three great duties: he must respect his ruler, he must love and obey his father, and he must honor his teacher."
paragraphs.zh: “好吧，”哈里发说，“如果你禁止他们这样尊敬你，我就会认定你错了。他们所做的事，并没有辱没王子的尊严。事实上，他们尊敬你，也尊敬了自己。”阿尔·法拉深深鞠躬，没有说话。哈里发接着说：“无论年轻人还是男孩，地位再高，也不能忽视三大责任：必须敬重统治者，必须爱戴并服从父亲，必须尊敬老师。”

paragraphs.en: Then he called the two young princes to him, and as a reward for their noble conduct, filled their pockets with gold.
paragraphs.zh: 然后他把两个小王子叫到身边，为了奖赏他们高尚的行为，把他们的口袋装满了金币。
